shortDescription: Retrieves the vulnerability outputs for a plugin recorded on a specified asset.

options.name: access_key
options.description: The access key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_ACCESS_KEY or passed directly to the module.

options.name: asset_id
options.description: The UUID of the asset for which vulnerability details are to be retrieved.

options.name: date_range
options.description: The number of days of data prior to and including today that should be returned.

options.name: filter_search_type
options.description: Specifies whether to use the 'AND' or 'OR' logical operator for multiple filters. Default is 'AND'.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply to the asset search. Each filter is a dictionary that includes 'type', 'operator', and 'value'. For agent filters use the list_agent_filters module or check https://developer.tenable.com/reference/io-filters-agents-list . For asset filters use the list_asset_filters module or check https://developer.tenable.com/reference/io-filters-assets-list . options.name: plugin_id
options.description: The ID of the plugin associated with the vulnerability data.

options.name: secret_key
options.description: The secret key required to authenticate with the Tenable.io API. This key can be set as an environment variable named TENABLE_SECRET_KEY or passed directly to the module.
